name: Castrol India Ltd
about: Castrol India Ltd is principally engaged in the business of manufacturing & marketing of automotive and industrial lubricants and related services.[1]
keyPoints: Parentage[1][2] The company is part of the BP group, a global integrated energy company engaged across oil and gas, fuels and convenience, EV charging, supply and trading, shipping, and energy technology. In Dec 2025, British Petroleum announced an agreement to sell a 65% stake in the company to Stonepeak at an enterprise value of approximately US$10 Bn, while retaining a 35% minority stake. The transaction is now completed and Stonepeak, a Private Equity player has recenty acquired the Castrol business from its parent British Petroleum and hence, there is now a change in the parentage of the company.
pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.61%.
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 43.4%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 109%
cons: Stock is trading at 9.84 times its book value
